identity.title: Joint feasible-set support is strictly narrower than the product box on a coupled polytope

claims: joint support sup_F (x+y) = 1 (the coupling x+y<=1 binds)
joint sup 1 < product sup 2: the joint identified set is STRICTLY narrower than the product box
removing the coupling gives joint sup = product sup = 2 (product box is the factorized corollary)

notes: Wolfram/SymPy/Sage solve the exact LP over the rational polytope; Lean and Rocq (independent kernels) verify the exact strict inequality 1 < 2 and that the coupling constraint bounds the joint sup at 1. No majority vote; all five axes PASS.
